# Third-party art

| File | Author | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `yar_iso_64x64_outside.png` | Yar | CC-BY 3.0 | https://opengameart.org/content/isometric-64x64-outside-tileset |

Eden uses cells cut from this sheet (rocks, bushes, tall grass) via `art/scripts/export_yar.py`. In the game they are recoloured onto Eden's own colour ramps for each season (`src/sprites.js`, `yarProps`). CC-BY 3.0 requires credit to the author; the opening card in `index.html` carries it.
